Numerous bug fixes across Mac builds, audio, achievements, menus, and offline play compatibility.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support and feedback![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2457030/GT_Manager/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: GT MANAGER FULL RELEASE
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Today is a big day — GT Manager is officially out of Early Access! 

 We want to thank each and every one of you who supported us during this phase. Your feedback, bug reports, and enthusiasm helped shape the game into what it is today.

For this official release, we’re bringing a major update packed with improvements, new content, and gameplay balancing to greatly improve your racing and management experience. 

[h3][b]Here's a sneak peak at what you'll be able to enjoy with this new version:[/b][/h3]

[b]Team messages improvements[/b]
 We've improved team communications both during races and at HQ, making messages more relevant, clearer, and helpful for your decision-making.

[b]New cars & achievements[/b]
 New exclusive liveries are available, but you'll need to earn them through brand new achievements!

[b]Buildings unlock changes[/b]
Private testings, the marketing building and the aerodynamic department are now unlocked when you reach GT3, improving progression pace and better strategic planning earlier in your career.

[b]AI inventory balancing
[/b] We've fine-tuned the AI teams’ inventory system for a fairer and more competitive experience across all racing categories.

[b]Tire strategy & driver stamina balancing[/b]
 A major update to tire strategy and stamina systems now makes race management more realistic and rewarding, but also more challening: timing and endurance matter more than ever.

[b]Enhanced car engine sounds[/b]
 We’ve added new engine audio for a more immersive racing atmosphere

[b]Economy balancing[/b]
 We’ve worked on rebalancing the game economy to make revenues, costs and investment decisions more coherent and strategic throughout your career.

[b]Upgrade difficulty balancing[/b]
Difficulty levels have been reworked to better match your different playstyles and expectations. Whether you're early or late game, you'll now find upgrade paths more consistent with difficulty levels.

[b]Bug Fixes & Optimization[/b]
We’ve fixed numerous bugs reported during Early Access, including UI improvement, gameplay inconsistencies, sound issues, and performance hiccups.
 This patch includes general stability improvements, better optimization, and a smoother overall experience for all players.

[b][u][i]Thank you again for being part of the journey — from Early Access to full release.[/i][/u][/b]

notes.title: GT MANAGER UPDATE #4
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Thank you for all the feedback you've given us, and for the all the support. For this update, we've listened to your feedback and wanted to work on improving your game experience!

This major update brings a number of bug fixes, improvements to existing systems and the arrival of new systems such as water on track. 

[h3][b]Here's the main list of new features for GT Manager update #4[/b]
[/h3][list]
[*][b]Water on track[/b] -a new feature displaying track humidity in real time as the weather changes to rain or sun. Adapt your tires and choose the best time to equip the right set in order to optimize your performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44798891/20e2b257a7a0a15f04b1f3e1ad61f92f95f85c4a.png[/img]
[i]Improved layout, addition of the water on track indicator and addition of temperature and humidity trend indicators
[/i]
[*][b]Pit stop new flow & information[/b] -more details are given to aim at improving your efficiency with more in-depth analysis regarding pit stop times.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44798891/39edaedf5f8c3bcd7706908591b633a5281206b5.png[/img]
[i]Pit stop in the event of a double stack where you can see the impact of poor stop management on the race (+3.67s lost during this double stack).[/i]

[*][b]Season team objective[/b] -a new objective is now set by the team to try and reach the best outcome possible for the championship.
[*][b]Championship leaderboard at the end of race[/b] -you have now a much better follow-up on team rankings in the championship after each race of the season.
[*][b]Building and department system rework[/b] -you are the manager, you get to choose what you want to build and when. Be strategic about your investments to find the best way to optimize your team performance.
[*][b]New building popup information[/b] -information is now given in each building to provide everything needed for you to make the right decisions.
[*][b]Difficulty balancing[/b] -difficulty levels have been balanced to ensure you have the experience you want: easy, medium or hard.
[*][b]Main Sponsor[/b] -before the Season Sponsor, the Main Sponsor now gives you race rewards after each race results, as well as a bonus at the end of the season based on your performance.
[*][b]Race and player progression balancing[/b] -new items availability, prices and costs... improvements have been made in various areas based on your feedback and series of tests.
[*][b]Numerous bug fixes[/b] -your experience will be consequently improved with less bugs.
[*][b]Optimization for improved performance[/b] -we believe all players should be able to enjoy a smooth experience, therefore we have been working hard on accessibility with different levels of graphic quality and game fluidity.
[*][b]Various visual polish, UI/UX improvements[/b]
[*][b]Major optimisation of localisation[/b] - We worked on improving the texts, which could be too large and not properly translated into certain languages.
[/list]

notes.title: COMING SOON UPDATE #4 WITH A FOCUS ON GAME BALANCING
notes.content:
The 4th update of GT Manager is coming in about a week.

 This new update will offer major balancing improvements both at the team’s headquarter and during the race.
In Easy and Medium difficulty, the team now starts with a bigger budget and costs and earnings are better balanced, offering the opportunity to expand the HQ much faster in the first 2 seasons. 

The experience points are also better distributed to offer more opportunities to train drivers and staff members. More Staff, Drivers and Equipments are also available in the early game. Finally, the Manufacturer’s cup are now available from season 1 and offer higher cash rewards.

During the race, the top view features more graphic details and many race elements have been rebalanced like the tire degradations, the mechanical failure sensitivity, the fuel consumption or the drivers’ fatigue. The race strategy now plays a much bigger role in the race result.
Stay tune for the complete list of improvements coming with the update #4.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44798891/6add119d776b70a6a49462d0913a0aa35a424670.png[/img]

notes.title: GT MANAGER UPDATE #3
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Thank you for all the feedback you've given us, and for the support you give us. We've listened to all your suggestions and we've tried to make as many as possible for this Update #3.

This update brings a whole host of bug fixes and system optimizations already available in the game, but the major addition of this update is the arrival of the save system!

[h2] [b]Bug fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Players can now enter the showroom without issues after a builder's race.
[*]Boosted AI has been adjusted for better gameplay balance.
[*]Objectives now validate the correct position as required.
[*]Tyre strategies are displayed correctly, even for races ending before 15 or 30 laps.
[*]The constructors' progress bar now updates and displays properly.
[*]Various incorrect text displays have been fixed throughout the game.
[*]Changing the game language now updates option texts immediately.
[*]Camera issues at pit lane entrances and exits on the Indian track have been resolved.
[*]Visual issues with water shading at certain times of day have been corrected.
[*]Gameplay has been tweaked and balanced to improve the overall experience.
[/list]
[h2] [b]Balancing and adjustment[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Increased impact of tyre durability.
[*]Balancing of engine and tyre temperatures (with fixed values).
[*]Engine and tyre temperatures rounded to ‘0.00’.
[*]Balancing of medium tyres (improved durability).
[*]Fuel consumption reduction and ‘push to pass’ correction.
[/list]
[h2] [b]Cards and economy :[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Rebalancing of card distribution.
[*]Adjustment of sponsor values and race team salaries.
[/list]
[h2] [b]New: Save system[/b][/h2]

We're delighted to introduce a much-requested feature: the save system integrated into the main menu! 

Now you can:
[list]
[*]Save your progress easily at any time from the main menu.
[*]Pick up exactly where you left off, whether you're in the middle of the season or managing your teams and sponsors.
[*]You can have several saves and therefore several seasons at the same time!
[/list]
[h2] [b]Addition of new cars[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]3 new Acura cars

- ACURA ARX-06
- ACURA NSX GT3 EVO
- ACURA NSX GT3 EVO TEAM MOTUL
[/list]
[h2]CHANGELOG 0.9.1-> 0.9.2 :[/h2]

Here is the full list of changes made for this update:
[list]
[*]Adding new team messages in race
[*]The driver's stamina displays only one "0" instead of two when it's worn out
[*]The tire degradation is now properly displaying on the icon above the car
[*]The hover stats' bubbles are now displaying above the pit stop reminder
[*]The hover feedback of the selected pilot is now activated only when we hover it and not when we select him (shortcut included)
[*]The icon category of the season is now properly updated in the qualification result
[*]The feedback of the trail behind the car when they are at third speed is now disactivated when there is a yellow flag
[*]The order of the labels modifiers is fixed in the practice
[*]The color of the tire degradation slider located on the badge of the pilot 3D is the same color of the [*]type of the tyre used
[*]The feedback of the yellow flag on the first speed is now removed in the pit stop when the full yellow course is disactivated
[*]In practice, the pilots' images in the result and historic are replaced by their name (3 letters)
[*]Fix text "finished" by "OUT" in race leaderboard on LAP state
[*]Fix weather prediction text, it can't be 0 or maxLap + 1
[*]Update Main Menu (garage) scene Lighting + Anims
[*]The fast forward button animation is reset between two practice laps
[*]The time of the pit stop when there is a refuel and a driver swap is now correct
[*]The option's texts are directly changing when we swap language
[*]3 new Acura cars
[*]Update India camera entry and exit pit lane position
[*]fix water shader issue with day time
[*]System of time of the day
[*]Cards import with new researcher stats
[*]Balancing cards distribution
[*]Balancing economy (sponsors value & Racing crew staff salary)
[*]Activating FCY panels on the track during a FCY
[*]Fix can't enter showroom after a manufacturer race
[*]Balancing global des stats in race:
[*]Up the Tire durability impact
[*]Engine temperature balancing (and fix value)
[*]Round engine and tire temperature to 0.00 format
[*]Balance tire temp
[*]Medium tire balancing (more durability)
[*]Fuel balancing (lower consumption and push to pass fix)
[*]Fix manufacturer when the IAs don't have the proper PI
[*]The displaying of the manufacturer progression bar is now working correctly
[*]Fix boost IAs
[*]IAs during the qualifying start at 10 liters instead of 50 liters
[*]The engine temperature is no longer reset at 80 during a pilot swap
[*]Fix on the manufacturer's objectives when a car located a place below the objective still validate it
[*]The engine temperature continue to decrease when the car is in the pit stop
[*]The tires strategy is displaying properly in the race result when the race ends before 15 or 30 laps
[*]New formula upgrade for the cards stats (+5%)
[*]New design for the "completed" label in the manufacturer and championship
[*]It's possible to select only the season sponsor
[*]The bloom option is disactivated with the quality medium
[*]Feature main menu with the save system
[/list]

notes.title: GT MANAGER UPDATE #2
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

First of all, the entire development team would like to thank you for your feedback. We truly appreciate your valuable suggestions and patience, which inspire us to keep working towards enhancing GT Manager with new features.

This update focuses on new content to provide you a better overall experience.
Here are the key points of this update : 


[h2] [b]Race [/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]We have implemented on the circuits, a new weather and temperature dynamic system. You will now have a different environment depending on the time of day (start of the day, middle of the day and end of the day).
[*]To make the gameplay even more exciting and strategic, we're introducing a new stat: [b]driver stamina[/b]. This new stat adds an extra dimension to the race management alomg with the driver swap 
 during pit stops.
[*]We've also introduced 3 new types of in-race classification, designed to give you even more information in real time. These new feedbacks will allow you to analyse the situations more accurately to adjust your strategy as the race progresses.
[*]Pit stop animation : Following some feedback from players we have improved the pit stop animation sequence. We have improved the refuelling, tyre change and driver swap animations.
[*]We've added 3 levels of difficulty impactimg the performance of the AI controlled teams. Experienced players will now have a bigger challenge. To change the difficulty, simply go to the settings when you're in the HQ.
[/list]
[h2][b]Management [/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]We have balanced staff and equipment stats and added 7 new pieces of equipment and Merchandising items (4 Brembo brakes and 3 Buisnessolver merchandising items).
[*]Now you can change your drivers and sponsors after each race. You'll be able to adapt your team and your sponsors to maximise your performance during the season!
[/list]
[h2] [b]Global [/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]New circuits available: get ready to race on the circuits of[b] France, Germany and Hungary.[/b] 
[*] We've also added two new cars: The [b]Nissan GT-R Nismo GT3[/b] and The [b]Peugeot 9X8 2024[/b].
[*]Many of you asked us to add keyboard shortcuts... and now we have! They're now available to make your races even smoother and more immersive. To discover all the shortcuts, simply open the options menu by pressing F1 during a race.
[*]We've done a lot of balancing work on all the cars in the game to make sure the racing experience is fair for everyone.
[/list]

[h2]CHANGELOG 0.9.1-> 0.9.2 :[/h2]

Here is the full list of changes made for this update:

[h3][b]Improvements, additional content & polish :[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Add lap time next to drivers name
[*]Sprint/endurance differentiation - Championship Menu tiles
[*]Animation team message (improved animation + different colors + addition of circle + responsive)
[*]Appearance of driver stats in races
[*]HQ: modification of new items indicators
[*]Weather and lap UI :
- Correction of the background weather animation
- Fixed lap animation where missing a frame
- Fixed a bug when the weather changes at the same time as a lap
- New animation for future weather
- Remove "?" feature
[*] New fast forward animation
[*]Implement new Track distribution to avoid random positioning for endurance races
[*]Retake of the text system which indicates when the next weather arrives
[*]UI retake on car reliability and pull temperature
[*]Integrate new Picture In Picture UI
[/list]
[h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Fix lag issue when selecting items by delaying item instantiation over multiple frames
[*]Fix rain drop direction top view and update fog
[*]Fix inventory scrolling with items already equipped
[*]Fix the problems with the billboard button for building buildings during animation
[*]The pit stop sign is removed when the car is DNF
[*]Fix the monthly earning in the financial menu for race sponsors
[*]Fixing double blue feedback in the championship screen leaderboard
[*]Fix color text in the Podium sequence at the end of a season
[*]Fix : In Practice, when you come back from the 1st race there's only one car left in the garage
[*]Fix arrow decrease animation with fast forward enabled
[*]Fix for top view & picture and picture
[*]Fix the bug that the UI disappeared when any car crossed the finish line
[*]Fix the Best Lap / Last Lap / Yellow flag overlap bug in manufacturing
[/list]

notes.title: GT MANAGER UPDATE #2 COMING SOON
notes.content:
GT Manager Update #2 is on its way. For this new update, we've concentrated on adding new content: 

[b]New Additions:[/b]
In this update, we’re introducing two new car models, two new race tracks, additional drivers, and two new game partners—more details coming your way in the next days. To make races even more engaging, we’ve implemented a driver stamina feature that diversifies racing strategies for optimal performance.

Following your feedback, you now have the option to modify race sponsors and drivers throughout the season. This greater flexibility allows for more dynamic results and greater financial choices during the season. In addition we’ve added keyboard shortcuts for quicker and more streamlined controls. We recognize this feature was highly anticipated, and we’re pleased to bring this enhancement in Update #2.

[b]Enhanced AI Performance:[/b]
Our team has refined the AI to improve its difficulty and strategic decision-making, creating a more challenging and realistic race experience.

[b]Upgraded HUD and Pitstop System:[/b]
We've enhanced the HUD for better readability and more information during the races. The pitstop animation sequence has been enhanced, offering smoother animations and improved visual clarity.

We hope you will enjoy those additions and improvements when Update #2 will be released. Stay tuned as we continue to develop and improve the game, always with your feedback in mind!

notes.title: GT MANAGER UPDATE #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

First of all, the entire development team would like to thank you for your invaluable feedback, which is essential to the success of the Early Access phase. Your suggestions and patience deeply resonate with us, and it is thanks to this that we continue striving towards an improved GT Manager with new features.
This first update mainly focuses on enhancing and optimizing the existing game content to provide you with a better overall experience.
Here are the key points of this update:

[h3]RACE[/h3]
[list]
[*] Race balancing: Many race parameters have been adjusted to improve conditions, especially regarding cars (physics, tire and engine temperature calculations), drivers, consumables, and AI behavior.
[*] New fuel mechanic: From now on, fuel management (now in liters instead of percentages) is no longer limited to 50% or 100%, giving you much more freedom in your choices. Will you make the right strategic decisions to optimize your performance?
[*] Improved and more immersive weather system, especially for endurance races. Staying attentive to weather conditions will be crucial to seizing opportunities during the race, especially against opponents whose teams can provide valuable weather information that might give them an advantage.
[*] Enhanced race HUD to highlight important information and bring more realism. You now benefit from more precise indicators and metrics.
[/list]

[h3]MANAGEMENT[/h3]
[list]
[*] Progression: Unlocking a new championship category is achieved by securing a podium finish in the current championship. Want to move up to the next level? You'll need to prove you're among the best!
[*] Adjustments to economy and team members: Sponsor rewards, maintenance costs, salaries, experience... With these changes, you'll have the opportunity to earn better amounts and maximize your investment potential… provided you perform well, of course!
[*] Investments: You now have quicker access to certain buildings and receive more frequent and clearer opportunities for new equipment or recruitment.
[*] Inventory: Optimized inventory display and sorting in the management buildings. This way, you won’t miss out on new opportunities regarding equipment or recruitment for your team!
[/list]

[h3]GLOBAL[/h3]
We’ve listened to your feedback and made sure to incorporate it into this update’s improvements. For example:
[list]
[*] Greatly improved game performance for optimal use.
[*] Removed all blocking elements and fixed many major bugs you reported.
[*] Increased the maximum number of characters available for your team name.
[*] Added flags from several countries in your team options.
[/list]

Here is the full list of changes made for this update:

[h2]CHANGELOG 0.9.0b -> 0.9.1 :[/h2]

[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] Balance weather changes during races
[*] Add a third potential weather change in endurance races
[*] Add fuel impact on qualification
[*] Balancing car stats
[*] Rework physics
[*] Rework engine temperature
[*] Building balancing unlock date
[/list]

[h3]Performance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved vegetation performance
[*] Optimized framerate during top view and fast forward
[*] Added the possibility to deactivate shadows in options menu
[*] Optimized geometry visible during garage view before the race
[*] Fixed Particles quality settings
[*] Improved reflection system before the race
[*] Overall reduced bloom impact visually and on framerate
[*] Improved detection of hardware to select a quality settings level
[/list]

[h3]Improvements, additional content & polish[/h3]
[list]
[*] Remove 0 from laps text (01 to 1)
[*] Race HUD: in the race, team messages can now appear on the right, left, or center. The sorting order has been changed to appear in front of the Picture-in-picture but behind the options menu
[*] Pause the raindrop FX when the game is paused
[*] Add car maintenance price in the car factory and remove the car brand
[*] Make the music transition from HQ to Showroom smoother
[*] Unequip drivers when changing categories
[*] Update pit stop reminder time in the pit stop summary
[*] Update car sprites in 3/4 view that were blurry
[*] Add flags + missing team icon
[*] Player names now have a 25-character limit
[*] New inventory system
[*] New category unlocking system: cups + unlocking the next category upon a podium finish + new texts and new UI
[*] New fuel system
[*] Research building: locked tiles now have fully responsive condition text
[*] Visual rework of the team message animation appearance. A small radio wave appears beforehand, and team messages are no longer dull gray
[*] Replace "season amount" text with "season expense" in the expense sheet of the season tab
[*] Set fuel to 50L each time you enter the garage
[*] Add new weather animation
[*] Add "press any key to skip"
[*] Remove items levels when they haven't been discovered
[*] Remove static batching from most props to let SRP Batcher work
[*] Cash balance can go negative (subject to changes in next updates)
[*] Link hide team message animation
[*] Implement rain effect in top view
[*] Race and progression balancing
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Garage camera fix
[*] Fix responsive banners during the race
[*] Fix on marketing researcher
[*] Fix weather lap change
[*] Fix responsive weather change animation
[*] Fix best lap background wide responsiveness
[*] Fix monthly cost with starting level
[*] Fix the issue where engine regeneration animations continued playing in pause mode
[*] Fix logo ratios in team profiles
[*] Fix weather issues
[*] Fix pit stop time to match the estimated time

[*] Race income: Cards with two-digit levels will no longer move to the next line
[*] Team profile: "Enter a team name" with the correct font
[*] Fix race abandonment pop-up text
[*] Fix in-race sound issue where the alarm kept triggering at the start of the race and displaying fuel in liters
[*] Car settings text tutorial invalid keys fixes
[*] Add the missing team in GT4
[*] Pit stop summary padding fix issue
[*] Fix responsive text "press space to skip" (loading screens) that was off-screen in wide format
[*] Fix bug where tire details had missing keys
[*] Fix qualification text for 1st position is "Pole position" + Race result text for 1st position is "Winner"
[*] Fix jerrycan sprite when at 100L and 0
[*] Anti-bounce fix for buttons that changed positions + pit stop buttons in top view and in 3D
[*] Fix bug in top view where you could remain stuck in that screen at the end of a practice lap
[*] Fix button to indicate new items are available
[*] Racing crew building fix, the monthly cost was missing in the racing crew
[*] Fix bug where you could display 16 laps in sprint and 31 in endurance
[*] Fix bug where team messages disappeared too quickly
[*] Fix card level-up issue where upgrading a level 2 card to level 3 didn't increase the stats
[*] Fix max item issue where you couldn't launch a race

[/list]

The next update will bring a lot of new content (tracks, car liveries, gameplay...), so stay tuned to not miss out!

notes.title: PATCH NOTES #1
notes.content:
Hi all,

Based on your feedback and our desire to improve day by day, we are pleased to present our first patch note of the Early Access. 


[b]Race balancing:[/b] Many players told us that the game was too easy and allowed one strategy to win every race. [b]The AIs have been enhanced [/b]with [b]greater adaptability[/b] and a more comprehensive understanding of their fuel load. This, coupled with a [b]better balancing[/b] between [b]car acceleration[/b] and [b]fuel load[/b], has led to [b]more competitive racing.[/b]
Furthermore, the AI strategies have been refined to prioritize those with multiple pit stops, preventing the use of tires that have reached their maximum performance potential. Additionally, the tire degradation process has been optimized. 
We have also [b]corrected[/b] the [b]wet speed[/b] and [b]tire degradation[/b] to make them more perceptible to the player and increase the challenge of the races.


[b]Economies and team management balancing:[/b] We have made [b]significant changes[/b] to most [b]revenues[/b] and [b]expenses[/b] to make the first few seasons [b]more manageable[/b] for the players. The changes mainly [b]target building expenses, race sponsorship and season sponsorship. [/b]
We've also decided to [b]increase the number of crews and car parts[/b] at the start of [b]the first seasons[/b] to give [b]HQ more depth[/b] from the start of the experience.


[i][u][b]Once again, thank you for your comments. It's thanks to all your messages that we're able to improve GT Manager according to your wishes and we'll continue to make regular updates to satisfy you all.[/b][/u][/i]

notes.title: Development Update & New Early Acces Date
notes.content:
Dear Managers,

We have an important update to share with you regarding the release of [b]GT Manager[/b].
After careful consideration, we’ve made the decision to [b]postpone the Early Access release by two weeks[/b].

Instead of launching on [b]September 3rd[/b], we are now targeting a new release date of [b]September 18th[/b].

This additional time will help us ensure we deliver the best possible experience for you. In appreciation of your patience and support, we’re excited to share some exclusive development updates:
[list]
[*] [b][i]Extended Race Lengths:[/i][/b] Based on your feedback, we are making the races longer, sprint races will now be 15 laps, and endurance races will be 30 laps. This also implies rebalancing all stats and strategies to enhance gameplay.
[*] [i][b]HQ and Team Management Evolution:[/b][/i] We’re fine-tuning the budget and costs to ensure a well-balanced management experience. The HQ is being reworked and your progression will be visually more impactful as you advance from an emerging team manager to an elite team, you’ll start with a modest base of operations and see it evolve as you advance through the leagues.
[*] [i][b]Content Updates:[/b][/i] All cars, liveries, and drivers are currently being implemented. Stay tuned as we reveal the full lineup for each category in the coming days.
[*] [i][b]Visual and Audio Enhancements:[/b][/i] We’re polishing 3D and 2D elements, introducing exciting new animations like podium celebrations, and updating the race HUD. Additionally, we are working on sound improvements regarding race atmosphere and car engines.
[/list]
Our primary goal is to make [b]GT Manager[/b] as enjoyable as possible, and we believe this brief delay will help us achieve that.

We appreciate your understanding and look forward to seeing you on September 18th!

- [b]THE TINY DIGITAL FACTORY Team[/b]

notes.title: Announcing GT Manager Early Access date!
notes.content:
The chance to lead a championship-winning team in the world of GT racing arrives in September! 

[previewyoutube=8H4Y6Na9CaU;full][/previewyoutube]

Featuring 5 racing categories from GT4 to Hypercars, 25 iconic racing cars from 16 world-renowned manufacturers, 40 official drivers, and 35 official Endurance teams, we are gearing up to take you on a whistle-stop tour of the world of motorsports! 

Transform your fledgling GT4 squad into a dominant force in the world-renowned Hypercar championship. In GT Manager, you’ll build your dream driver lineup, assemble an elite team of mechanics to ensure smooth operations in the pit lane and secure lucrative sponsorships to fuel your rise to the top and maximise your car’s performance.

As head honcho, every decision is crucial! Will you recruit a hotshot driver or prioritise car upgrades? Will you squeeze out raw speed or focus on generating greater traction through the corners? Push the boundaries with aggressive fuel strategies, knowing extra pit stops could cost you the win; it's your team, so the buck stops with you! 

Your journey begins in the competitive, talent-rich world of GT4. As you climb the ladder of racing categories, new challenges and strategic decisions will test your leadership at every turn. GT Manager's extensive progression system ensures a steady stream of fresh content and strategic dilemmas, keeping rookie and veteran racing managers alike on the edge of their seats.

"[i]As you progress, the game evolves, revealing layers of complexity and strategic depth across its five distinct categories. It's a journey that starts with accessible fun and grows into a rich, multifaceted challenge that will test players’ management skills to the fullest.[/i]", said Stéphane Baudet, Creative Director at The Tiny Digital Factory.

Following February's Steam Fest, we gathered valuable feedback from the community and have been diligently refining the game's mechanics, focusing on both the team factory management and the racing experience.

[b]Under The Hood:
[/b][list]
[*] Transform a regional factory into a tech powerhouse with cutting-edge facilities and research departments
[*] Scout talents, recruit top engineers, and train your crew for perfect pit stops
[*] Research and develop new parts to make your car unbeatable on the track, balancing performance and reliability in the pursuit of perfection
[*] Practice between races to customise every aspect of your car’s performance on every track of the championship and under various weather conditions
[*] Oversee team budget and investments with an extensive financial board to balance the books
[*] Anticipate opponents’ moves and make crucial calls on pit stops, fuel level, tyre strategy, and driver pace to maximise your chance of victory
[*] Make split-second decisions to capitalise on race incidents, yellow flags,  and weather changes
[*] Featuring 25 official racing cars across the GT4, GT3, GT2, GTE, and Hypercar categories, new cars will be added to the game during Early access.
[*] Cars officially licensed from Porsche, Mercedes, BMW, Audi, Aston Martin, Peugeot, Alpine, Lotus, Ford, Glickenhaus, Chevrolet, Corvette, Brabham, Bugatti, KTM and Saleen.
[/list]
GT Manager will be released at a discounted €19.99 (rising to €24.99 at full launch), available as a Deluxe Edition that includes the Aston Martin Valkyrie AMR Pro and Bugatti Bolide.

notes.title: Interview with Stéphane Baudet, Founder & CEO of The Tiny Digital Factory
notes.content:
[i][b]Can you walk us through a typical day in your role at TDF and how it contributes to the overall success of GT Manager?[/b][/i] 

➡️ My role at The Tiny Digital Factory is to lead and direct the creative aspects of the game along with managing the studio. On a typical day, I work in the morning with game designers and artists to define the high level design of the next game features and content to be included in the next milestones. My afternoons are mostly about reviewing in-progress features or assets. 

Our work on the project is very collaborative, co-design and co-development is very frequent. It is important for me that all the developers on the project take ownership of their individual contribution from design until polish and debug and give their opinions and feedback on the overall game during frequent game reviews. 

[i][b]In your opinion, what sets GT Manager apart from other racing management games currently available in the market?[/b][/i] 

➡️ There aren’t that many quality racing management games on PC, especially in the GT or Endurance categories.

Although I enjoyed playing both F1 Manager and Motorsport Manager, I felt one was very realistic and visually stunning, but not so great to play, and the other had great core mechanics, but its content is not about real cars and drivers and it looks a bit dated.

Therefore, GT Manager was designed to offer the best of both worlds: great core mechanics with AAA officially licensed content (cars, teams and drivers). The GT world is less restrictive than F1, offering more opportunity to mix brands, teams and drivers, which is the key to a great management game. The large number of GT categories also provide an opportunity for a longer career progression starting from GT4 to Hypercars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44798891/d149fa0bab1053c3dedde403002340d76ab808e0.png[/img]

[i][b]Are there any specific user feedback or suggestions that have significantly influenced the direction of the game's development?[/b][/i] 

➡️ At The Tiny Digital Factory, we are in direct connection with our player community. We always had the idea of developing or racing management on PC along with our mobile game, but we felt we should build a different game.

We had many detailed player feedbacks about what they wanted to see next in GT Manager, but most of the time, those were great ideas, but not necessarily appropriate for a short session type mobile game.

Based on our own vision and those player feedbacks, It took us about a year to design GT Manager  before we started its development in January 2023. Features like the driver swap during races and the team budget were among the features often requested by the player community.

[i][b]How do you balance incorporating realistic elements from the world of GT racing while ensuring that the game remains accessible and enjoyable for a broad audience?[/b][/i] 

➡️ This is probably where GT Manager is slightly different from its competitors. The overall accessibility and progressive introduction of management features through the game progression makes GT Manager more appropriate to an audience fan of GT cars and Endurance races than typical management game hard care players.

The race simulation remains very realistic, but cars, drivers and team stats are aggregated into simple stats such as car speed, acceleration, reliability or driver’s ability to overtake or drive under wet conditions.

We also let the player progress at his own pace, the best players will probably be promoted in the GT3 category at the end of their first season in GT4, while it will take maybe 2 seasons for more casual players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44798891/adea08771415dfe62840c2ee3218221264af9ab1.jpg[/img]

[i][b]GT racing has some unique characteristics – what are you looking to add to create that extra bit of magic?[/b][/i] 

➡️ When we launch, we want to make sure the game is built on a strong race simulation. We want each race to be fun to play and remain not 100% predictable.

Although making the most impactful investments at the factory is definitely a factor of success (cars and driver stats), the decisions to take during the race, based on the race events, are as important. Accidents, weather changes or alternative strategies are many events to master in order to make a difference at the end of the race. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44798891/2becc90348c777fd02649c94989777ed6ceef5f2.png[/img]

[i][b]Could you tell us more about the upcoming features?[/b][/i] 

➡️ Unlike most games, the Practice sessions are available at any time during the championship. You can go with your test team to every circuit of the championship ahead of the races to practice.

During the practice, you have 5 laps to evaluate your drivers’ raw performance, compare the different tires and adapt the setup of your car to the track specifics. Going to practice also increases the experience of your team and drivers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44798891/b29257a6f873df4b9a2765541f51ead908338185.jpg[/img]

[i][b]With more and more manufacturers coming to WEC, who do you think is going to win it this year?[/b][/i] 

➡️ I think Porsche will be one of the strongest contenders, but honestly we should have great battles both in WEC and IMSA. I don’t see Alpine, Lamborghini nor BMW strong enough yet.

We'll see you on the pit wall!
